scripts.title: delete all killbricks

game.name: Easy Obby but you get banned if you die!

scripts.features: Deletes all killbricks so you will never banned again. Made by chatgpt
scripts.script:
local killFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("KillObjects")
if not killFolder then
    warn("Папка KillObjects не найдена в workspace.")
    return
end

for _, part in ipairs(killFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        -- Проверяем наличие объекта TouchInterest среди дочерних элементов
        local hasTouchInterest = false
        for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "TouchInterest" then
                hasTouchInterest = true
                break
            end
        end

        -- Если есть TouchInterest, удаляем часть
        if hasTouchInterest then
            part:Destroy()
        end
    end
end
